newsitem.title: USA: Jennifer auditor will not affirm results.
newsitem.headline: Jennifer auditor will not affirm results.

text.p: Jennifer Convertibles Inc said on Friday that the retailer's independent auditors will not express an opinion on the company's financial statements for fiscal 1994 and 1995.

The firm, Richard A. Eisner & Co LLP, told the company that it had been unable to obtain sufficient documentation to render an unqualified opinion and that the company did not have an inadequate system of accounting controls, Jennifer said.
Jennifer said it is addressing the firm's concerns and has established an internal audit function.
